  }

  }
  .custom-sortable-table th.desc::after {

  }
  .custom-sortable-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {

  }
</style>

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll("#teamTable th").forEach((headerCell, columnIndex) => {
    headerCell.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const table = headerCell.closest("table");
      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      const isAscending = headerCell.classList.contains("asc");

      table.querySelectorAll("th").forEach(th => th.classList.remove("asc", "desc"));

      headerCell.classList.toggle("asc", !isAscending);
      headerCell.classList.toggle("desc", isAscending);

      rows.sort((rowA, rowB) => {
        const textA = rowA.children[columnIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
        const textB = rowB.children[columnIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();

        if (textA === "—" || textA === "") return 1;
        if (textB === "—" || textB === "") return -1;

        const comparison = textA.localeCompare(textB);
        return isAscending ? -comparison : comparison;
      });

      rows.forEach(row => tbody.appendChild(row));
    });
  });
</script>
